chunks: By this isnad from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah. He said: Al-Husayn ibn Yazid narrated to us from Isma'il ibn Muslim from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Sitting in the mosque waiting for the prayer is worship, as long as one does not commit an offense. It was said: O Messenger of Allah! What is the offense? He said: Backbiting.

key_terms.الاغتياب: Backbiting (gheeba) — mentioning something about an absent person that they would dislike
key_terms.الجلوس في المسجد: Sitting in the mosque — treated as an act of worship when done in anticipation of prayer
key_terms.الحدث: The nullifier/offense — here defined by the Prophet not as ritual impurity but as backbiting
key_terms.عبادة: Worship (ibada) — a broad term encompassing any devotional act, here applied to mosque-sitting
key_terms.لانتظار الصلاة: Waiting for the prayer — the intention that transforms sitting into worship

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about sitting in the mosque waiting for prayer?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) declares that sitting in the mosque in anticipation of prayer is itself an act of worship — provided one refrains from backbiting. This hadith establishes that the spiritual reward of mosque-waiting can be nullified by the sin of backbiting (gheeba), which is speaking ill of an absent person. The teaching connects the physical act of religious devotion (mosque attendance) with the moral obligation of guarding one's tongue, emphasizing that worship is holistic and encompasses both outer practice and inner/social conduct.

en.bilal-muhammad: By this isnad from Ahmad b. Abi Abdillah. He said: Al-Husayn b. Yazid narrated to us from Isma`il b. Muslim from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (as). He said:
The Messenger of Allah (s) said: Sitting in the mosque waiting for the prayer is worship for one who does not nullify. It was said: O Messenger of Allah! What is the nullifier? He said: Backbiting.
